body_markdown:
San Francisco’s Pier 80 came alive last month as fans packed the dance floor for this year’s Portola Music Festival. If you missed any of the fun or just want an encore, you can now watch select sets and performances from the event in our


[Portola video hub](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5IMCbQBLrQJDXOTg8QI) from artists including


[Chloé Caillet](https://open.spotify.com/artist/68ywCN6ZpInbcilOfLBa3a) ,


[Beltron](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1jgSqmZTBltb5O2L7ErmEP) b2b


[Ben Sterling](https://open.spotify.com/artist/79uJoLQkQ621xZy7MyH4uL) **,**[Groove Armada](https://open.spotify.com/artist/67tgMwUfnmqzYsNAtnP6YJ) ,


[Max Styler](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3NKKngINK1tP6BFy0WOyWk) ,


[Four Tet](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7Eu1txygG6nJttLHbZdQOh?si=MGbpnvrFSyub0HuGv1fs6Q) **,**[Zara Larsson](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1Xylc3o4UrD53lo9CvFvVg) ,


[Brunello](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7FZIk8RSha4GBa4ZEPuytU) , and


[Fcukers](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3UtzOHYm3lQALkKzVD4wyO) , plus more coming soon.


Since launching in 2022, Portola has partnered with Spotify to bring fans the ultimate festival experience, from official playlists to on-site art exhibits. This year, as the official music and video partner, we’re keeping the party going


—


and celebrating a milestone


—


by bringing longform video DJ sets to our platform for the first time.


Check out Four Tet’s set right[here](https://open.spotify.com/track/77iD9rx9l07jg2lSFKsHw2?si=81d8884df5164aa2&nd=1&dlsi=e2866e554f8845d1&autoplay_ok=1) .


While largely an electronic and dance music festival, Portola is also known for genre-spanning lineups, pairing electronic powerhouses like


[Skrillex](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5he5w2lnU9x7JFhnwcekXX) and


[Jamie xx](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7A0awCXkE1FtSU8B0qwOJQ) with pop icons


[Charli xcx](https://open.spotify.com/artist/25uiPmTg16RbhZWAqwLBy5) and


[Nelly Furtado](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2jw70GZXlAI8QzWeY2bgRc) . This year’s bill featured


[Tiësto](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2o5jDhtHVPhrJdv3cEQ99Z?si=_5N0yG19QeebzmqcV0XPhA) ,


[Marlon Hoffstadt](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0HHa7ZJZxUQlg5l2mB0N0f?si=xAyiPlW8S8KDnzCv-x64QA) ,


[Robyn](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6UE7nl9mha6s8z0wFQFIZ2) , who was continuing her long-awaited


[comeback](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-02-19/robyn-live-los-angeles-concert-film/) , and dozens of other artists.


With this new video offering, we’re giving the Portola performances a second life on Spotify—and giving fans a new, longform way to listen to their favorite artists.


*Stay tuned: sets from*[Marlon Hoffstadt](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0HHa7ZJZxUQlg5l2mB0N0f) *and*[VTSS](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0zo109NM3S7CqHpvlXwqEN) *are coming soon. In the meantime, stream our official*[Portola Party People](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX5LFAujdafjI?si=308551ec6b494350) *playlist and check out our*[Portola video hub](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5IMCbQBLrQJDXOTg8QI) *.*
